result:
I'd want people to develop genuine curiosity about each other. Not tolerance, not politeness — actual curiosity. The willingness to sit with someone whose beliefs or experiences are wildly different from yours and think, *I don't understand yet, but I want to.*

Most of the worst things we do to each other come from convincing ourselves we already know what someone is. Curiosity kills that shortcut. It's the one thing that can't be forced or faked — and it quietly makes everything else harder to hate.
